<thought>Search the template catalog for a Diels‑Alder type retrosynthetic template that breaks two C=C bonds (order change) and forms two new C–C single bonds. This will provide a template ID to use for the single‑step route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)", "6-6 (2.0->1.0)"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-6"]
}</action_input>
